prompts.text: Pineapple absolutely belongs on pizza.
Breakfast is the most overrated meal of the day.
Cats are objectively better pets than dogs.
Movie theaters are dying and that is a good thing.
Texting is better than calling every single time.
Social media has done more harm than good overall.
Working from home is strictly better than going to an office.
People who say they do not watch TV are the most boring people.
Being early is just as rude as being late.
The best pizza is cold leftover pizza.
Online friendships can be just as meaningful as in-person ones.
Weekends should be 3 days and anyone who disagrees works too much.
Fast food is actually better than most fancy restaurants.
Introverts are more interesting than extroverts.
Napping is a superpower that society does not respect enough.
A quiet evening at home is more romantic than a fancy restaurant.
The best friendships require very little maintenance.
Reading books as a personality trait is extremely overrated.
Paying for a gym membership you barely use is still worth it psychologically.
Giving unsolicited advice is almost always about the advice-giver, not the person they advise.
You can tell everything you need to know about a person from their Spotify playlist.
Ghosting is sometimes the kindest way to end things.
Everyone has a type and pretending you do not is lying to yourself.
Zodiac signs are as valid as personality tests for understanding people.
People who are perpetually late do not respect your time — that is the whole truth.
The friend who always cancels plans is secretly the smartest one in the group.
First impressions are almost always wrong.
Humor is more attractive than looks — anyone who disagrees has not met enough funny people.
Most travel photos are for other people, not for the traveler.
Being single is underrated and most people rush into relationships out of fear.
Group chats are more exhausting than they are worth.
People care far less about you than you think, and that is actually liberating.
Expensive coffee is a scam and anyone who says otherwise is a victim of branding.
The way someone treats a waiter tells you everything about their character.
Loyalty is more important than honesty in close friendships.
Most people who say they love to travel just want the Instagram pictures.
Saying 'sorry you feel that way' is the most manipulative non-apology there is.
The most dangerous type of person is one who never admits they are wrong.
Every person has at least one truly embarrassing secret they will carry to the grave.
Liking the same music as someone is more important for compatibility than liking their personality.
Long-term relationships are more about compatibility and habit than actual love.
It is impossible to stay just friends with someone you were once romantically attracted to.
People who say they do not play games in dating are lying — everyone does.
A complete lack of jealousy in a relationship is actually a red flag.
If someone cheats once, they will always be a cheater — people do not really change.
It is completely normal to research a potential partner's entire social media before a first date.
The talking stage should last no longer than two weeks — after that you are wasting time.
Most people are in relationships because they are scared of being alone, not because of love.
The way you fight with someone is more telling than how you feel when things are good.
Going through your partner's phone is justified if your gut is telling you something is wrong.
You can genuinely love someone and still fall for someone else at the same time.
Situationships exist because one person is too comfortable and the other is too afraid.
The person who ends the relationship first always had more power in it.
Long-distance relationships almost never work and people only try them because they hate endings.
It is a red flag if someone has no close friends from their past.
Exes can never truly be just friends — one person is always still a little bit in it.
Having a work spouse is completely harmless and people who disagree are just insecure.
People who say they love everyone form no deep connections with anyone.
The way you feel alone at 3 AM is more you than the version you show the world.
Everyone has an ideal partner in their head and almost nobody in real life lives up to it.
